assets.name: Battery Storage

assets.name: STP & Water Reuse
assets.note: Treated water goes to flushing and landscape. The twin treats the STP as an energy load, not just a water asset.

assets.name: Pumping & Distribution
assets.note: The hidden Scope 2 load. Pumping energy is small in kWh but continuous, and it is usually left out of carbon reporting.

assets.name: R1 Residences
assets.note: The EcoNiwas efficient case is 65% lower than business-as-usual. The twin tracks the gap between design intent and operation.

assets.name: School Campus
assets.note: Passive cooling, shading and efficient standalone AC before mechanical load. The school is the Phase 1 testbed for the envelope strategy.

assets.name: Campus Centre & Hospitality
assets.note: Shared amenities concentrate load and create the campus's evening peak. This is where demand flexibility matters most.

assets.name: Gaushala & Compost
assets.note: Aerobic composting avoids the methane a landfill would produce. The avoided emissions are shown, not silently netted off.

assets.name: Zugrama Compute Commons
assets.note: The only load on site that can move in time. The twin schedules inference into high-solar, low-carbon hours instead of running it flat out.
